intro: Nothing to answer here. This one is already done, so you can see what it looks like built.
source_document: Document 1 - Thomas Jefferson, letter to John Breckinridge, August 12, 1803

right.label: The United States bought the territory from France for $15 million. It doubled the size of the country and gave the United States the Mississippi River and the port of New Orleans.

rationale.a: The Constitution said nothing about buying land. Jefferson read it strictly, and it worried him, but he made the deal anyway - which is why Document 1 is him explaining himself.

frame_fill: After the Revolution, the young nation needed the Mississippi for trade. By 1803, Jefferson had bought Louisiana from France - even though the Constitution said nothing about buying land, and it worried him.
